chapter.verse: Topa aw, kei hong pangte langpang in la, kei hong dote do in!
Lum lian leh lum neu la in la, keimah hong huh in!
Teipi leh teitangzang dok in la kei hong delhte’ lam ngat in! Keima tungah, “Kei in nangma kihotkhiatna ka hi hi!” hong ci in.
Kei hong sawmte mai zumin mindaisak ta in! Keima siat nading a bawlte nungkiksak in la siasak ta in!
Topa ’ vantungmi’ hawlna tawh amaute huih letkhiat ansite tawh kibangsak in.
Topa ’ vantungmi’ delhna-ah a taina lampi uh mial-in nal sak in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in thu om lopi-in a ngenthang uh tawh kei hong siah uh a, thu om lopi-in gum to-in kei hong siah uh hi.
A phawk loh kalun amau tungah siatna tung sak in! Amau ngenthang siahsimna uh ah amaute mah awksak in la, a kisia dingin amaute kiasak in.
Tua ciangin Topa tungah ka lungdam ding a, ama hotkhiatna-ah nuamin ka diang ding hi.

Ka lungsim khempeuh tawh “ Topa aw, ama adinga a hat luate kiang panin a thahat lo mi a gumkhia, a neihsa a sutkhia mi kiang panin mi thahat lo a zawng a gumkhiapa ahi, nang tawh a kibang kua ahi hiam?” ka ci ding hi.
Mi a el tecite hong kipan uh a, ka theih loh thute kei hong dong uh hi.
Amaute in hoihnate siatna tawh kei tungah hong thuk uh a, ka khawngai mahmah hi.
Ahih hangin kei ahih leh, amaute a cinat uh ciangin—puanhampi silhin an tangin kei ka kigim tawmsak hi. Ka ang ah ka lu phumin thu ka ngen a,
ka lawm, ka sanggampa’ hanga dah bangin ka dah hi; a nu’ hanga kap mi bangin kapin ka vak kawikawi a, kunin ka kidikdik hi.
Ahih hangin kei ka tukna-ah amaute nuamin kikhawm uh a, keimah langpangin kikaikhawm uh hi; ka theih ngei loh khebaite nangawn in tawlnga loin kei hong gensia hi;
zahtakna mel nei loin hong zahko uh a, a ha uh kei hong gawisan uh hi.
Topa aw, bang tanvei hong en khong ding na hi hiam? Amau hong sukgawpna panin keimah hong honkhia in la, humpinelkaite kiang panin ka nuntakna hong hon in.
Tua ciangin mihon kikhopna lian sungah na tungah lungdamna kong ko ding a, mi honpite lak panin nang kong phat ding hi.
A man lopi-a ka gal a hite kei tungah lungdamsak kei in la, thu om lopi-a kei hong mudahte, mit-heek kipiasak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kilemna thu gen lo uh a, gam sunga dai taka mi omte lang pangin, khemna thu ngaihsun uh hi.
Amaute in kei hong kamkat beba uh a, amaute in, “Ha, Ha! mu khin hang ei!” ci uh hi.
Topa aw, na mu khin hi, dai om kei in! Topa aw, kei kiang panin gamla om kei in!
Ka Topa ka Pasian aw, ka thu hong thei in la, kei’ adingin nangmah hong kisosuah tawm in!
Topa ka Pasian aw, nangma thumanna tawh kituakin keima thutan’na hong langsak in la, amaute kei tungah lungdamsak kei in!
Amau leh amau tungah, “Ha, i tuptup tung ei!” kici sak kei in. “Amah nawmvalh tum khin hang,” amaute cisak kei in.
Kei’ kamsiatna-ah a lungdamte maizumsak in la zahhuai gawp sak in! Kei tunga hong kiliansakte maizumna leh mindaina silh sak in!
Kei’ thutan’na lah khiat ding a deihte lungdamin, awng-in, kipaksak in la, a tawntungin, “A nasempa’ hoihna-ah a lungkim Topa lian hi,” cici sak in.
Tua ciangin na thumanna leh nangmah phatna sunthapai-in ka gengen ding hi.
